At 12–20¢ the H15 Dual mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin side by side for $999, shipping November 14. Most people buy it for the shot at a block that keeps drawing every ten minutes, plus steady sats meanwhile.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
Read the bsb b30 dual page

Adding to a setup, the best value per TH we sell is the Magic Miner 40T — $799, BM1370, ships November 21. The Harlo B30 ($899, ships November 30) is the quieter enclosed build if noise matters where it sits.

The H15 Dual hasn't dropped yet, so it isn't buyable today. Which of those two fits better?
